episodes.instruction: Pick up red block, set it on the left. Then grab green block, position it next to red block. Finally, place blue block to the right of green block.
Use the right arm to arrange red block first, then use the left arm for green block, and finally use the right arm for blue block in a row.
Start by placing red block to the left, followed by green block next to red block, and end with blue block on the far right.
